items.title: Arthur Baron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And he actually got Leonard Cohen to recite some poetry

ctx.x: I did a lot of projects with him. My first project with him was an amazing project of doing Mingus. It was called “Weird Nightmare: Meditations on Mingus.” And I arranged a piece on that, on “Eclipse” in a totally different fashion, not about a black and white person in a couple, but about the first time mankind ever saw an eclipse, cavemen. And we had all these Harry Partch instruments, I played didgeridoo, all kinds of — and he actually got Leonard Cohen to recite some poetry, just a part of a poem that Mingus…
Well I don’t mind going to a place in our conversation where — this is not just a conversation about musicians but I’m interested in your general feeling about the state of our country.
